about.title: About Iredell-Statesville Schools
about.content: Iredell-Statesville Schools publishes student-year dates, teacher workdays, annual leave, holidays, professional-development early releases, grading dates, and school-specific calendar links for families in Iredell County, North Carolina.

about.title: Which I-SS Calendar Should You Use?
about.content: Most students use the district calendar. I-SS does not publish every school year in exactly the same way: the current 2026–27 page lists a separate N.B. Mills Elementary PDF, while the main district PDF lists different early-release dates for professional development at traditional schools and Early Colleges.

planningTips.title: I-SS Calendar Planning Notes
content: Check whether the district PDF, its Early College-specific markers, or a school-specific calendar applies to your student.
Check dismissal times with your child's school on early-release days scheduled for professional development.
Check the official I-SS calendar page again after a weather closure or district schedule change.

districtFaqs.q: Which Iredell-Statesville calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official Iredell-Statesville Schools traditional calendar PDFs for the listed school years.

I-SS does not publish every school year in exactly the same way. For 2026–27, it lists a separate N.B. Mills Elementary PDF, while the main district PDF lists different early-release dates for professional development at traditional schools and Early Colleges.

districtFaqs.q: Are I-SS teacher workdays student holidays?
districtFaqs.a: For family planning, teacher workdays and required teacher workdays are student no-school days unless the district announces a calendar change.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify I-SS calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Iredell-Statesville Schools calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with I-SS.
